name: Grande Mosquée de Conakry
subtitle: The Fayçal Mosque in the suburb of Donka was funded and designed by Saudi Arabia and Morocco.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Funded and designed by Saudi Arabia and Morocco; a building of the First Republic

facts.label: Disrepair
facts.value: In 2017: cracked walls, pierced roof, carpets removed

facts.label: Reopening
facts.value: Reopened on 22 March 2023 after several years of renovation

parts.text: The Fayçal Mosque in the suburb of Donka was funded and designed by Saudi Arabia and Morocco. It fell into disrepair and was reopened after renovation in March 2023.
